item.title: President Lee's Approval Rating Rebounds to 47% After 7 Weeks... Democratic Party 43%, People Power Party 40% (李대통령 지지율, 7주만에 반등 47%... 민주 43%·국힘 40%)
item.description:
President Lee's Approval Rating Rebounds to 47% After 7 Weeks... Democratic Party 43%, People Power Party 40% (李대통령 지지율, 7주만에 반등 47%... 민주 43%·국힘 40%)

A poll released on the 6th showed that President Lee Jae-myung's approval rating for state affairs has slightly rebounded after seven weeks. (이재명 대통령의 국정 수행 지지율이 7주 만에 소폭 반등했다는 여론조사 결과가 6일 나왔다.)

According to a survey by pollster Realmeter, commissioned by the Energy Economic Newspaper, conducted on 2,525 people aged 18 and over nationwide from the 29th of last month to the 3rd of this month, the positive assessment of President Lee's state affairs performance rose by 0.5 percentage points (p) from the previous week to 47.0%. The negative assessment fell by 0.3 points from the previous week to 49.2%. (여론조사 업체 리얼미터가 에너지경제신문 의뢰로 지난달 29일에서 지난 3일까지 전국 18세 이상 2525명을 대상으로 조사한 결과 이 대통령의 국정 수행 긍정 평가는 지난주보다 0.5%포인트(p) 오른 47.0%로 집계됐다. 부정 평가는 지난주 대비 0.3%p 내린 49.2%였다.)

In the same survey, President Lee's approval rating had been on a continuous decline since hitting 60.5% in the second week of May, but rebounded in this latest survey. (같은 조사에서 이 대통령 지지율은 5월 둘째주 60.5%를 기록한 이후 지속 하락하다가 이번 조사에서 반등했다.)

Realmeter analyzed that "the government's announcement of large-scale regional investment projects in the southwestern, Chungcheong, and Yeongnam regions, as part of its three major mega projects, served as a positive signal for the approval rating rebound." However, it added that "due to economic headwinds such as a stock market crash and a high exchange rate, the increase was limited." (리얼미터는 “정부의 3대 메가 프로젝트인 서남·충청·영남권 대규모 지역 투자 발표가 지지율 반등에 긍정적 신호로 작용했다”고 분석했다. 다만 “주가 급락과 고환율 등 체감 경기 악재가 이어지면서 상승 폭은 제한적인 수준에 그쳤다”고 했다.)

In a separate survey on party support conducted on 1,008 people aged 18 and over nationwide on the 2nd and 3rd of this month, the Democratic Party recorded 43.0%, and the People Power Party recorded 40.3%. (지난 2∼3일 전국 18세 이상 1008명을 대상으로 한 정당 지지도 조사에서는 더불어민주당이 43.0%, 국민의힘이 40.3%를 각각 기록했다.)

The Democratic Party rose by 2.0 percentage points compared to the previous survey, while the People Power Party fell by 1.7 percentage points. The approval rating for the Reform Party was 3.0%, the Fatherland Innovation Party 1.9%, and the Progressive Party 1.6%. Undecided voters accounted for 6.5%. (민주당은 지난 조사 대비 2.0%p 올랐고 국민의힘은 1.7%p 떨어졌다. 개혁신당 지지율은 3.0%, 조국혁신당은 1.9%, 진보당은 1.6%로 나타났다. 무당층은 6.5%로 기록됐다.)

Both surveys were conducted using wireless automated response methods. The margin of error for the presidential approval rating survey was ±2.0 percentage points at a 95% confidence level, with a response rate of 4.0%. The party support survey had a margin of error of ±3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level, with a response rate of 2.8%. For more details, refer to the website of the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission. (두 조사는 모두 무선 자동 응답 방식으로 이뤄졌다. 대통령 국정 수행 지지율 조사의 표본 오차는 95% 신뢰 수준에 ±2.0%p, 응답률은 4.0%였다. 정당 지지도 조사 응답률은 표본 오차 95% 신뢰 수준에 ±3.1%p, 응답률은 2.8%였다. 자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지 참조.)

item.title: Board of Audit and Inspection Launches On-Site Audit of Election Commission... Scrutinizes Ballot Printing Budget, Commission Staff Overseas Trips, and Overseas Election Officers (감사원, 선관위 현장 감사 착수… 투표용지 인쇄 예산, 선관위 직원 해외 출장, 재외선거관 파견 들여다본다)
item.description:
Board of Audit and Inspection Launches On-Site Audit of Election Commission... Scrutinizes Ballot Printing Budget, Commission Staff Overseas Trips, and Overseas Election Officers (감사원, 선관위 현장 감사 착수… 투표용지 인쇄 예산, 선관위 직원 해외 출장, 재외선거관 파견 들여다본다)

<<>> The Board of Audit and Inspection (BAI) began an audit of the National Election Commission (NEC) on the 6th. Although the BAI was barred from conducting a job inspection of the NEC following a Constitutional Court ruling in February last year, it can still perform accounting audits, and on the 24th of last month, it announced it would conduct an accounting audit of the NEC. ()

According to the BAI, 42 auditors from its Administrative and Safety Audit Bureau will begin on-site audits starting today at the central NEC, the Seoul, Gyeonggi, and Busan regional election commissions, and subordinate district-level commissions such as the Songpa District Election Commission. The first phase of the on-site audit will run for 19 days, including 14 working days, through the 24th of this month, with a second phase scheduled for next month over 14 working days. The BAI stated that based on the results of the first phase, it may expand the audit scope or conduct additional on-site audits if necessary. This involves deploying three to four times the usual manpower and time compared to a standard audit. (감사원이 6일 선거관리위원회에 대한 감사를 시작했다. 감사원은 지난해 2월 헌법재판소 결정으로 선관위를 직무 감찰할 수 없게 됐지만, 회계 검사는 할 수 있고, 지난달 24일 선관위를 회계 검사하겠다고 밝힌 바 있다.)

Through this, the BAI said it would focus on 12 key areas. The BAI stated, "We will inspect the status of election-related budget formulation and execution, including ballot printing and contracts, matters of significant public concern, and items needed to verify the NEC's self-reform efforts, to devise ways to resolve public doubts about the NEC." (감사원에 따르면, 감사원 행정·안전감사국 감사관 42명이 이날부터 중앙선관위와 서울·경기·부산선관위, 산하 송파구선관위 등 구·시·군선관위로 나가 실지감사(현장 조사)를 시작한다. 실지감사는 오는 24일까지 근무일 14일을 포함해 19일간 1차로 진행되고, 다음 달에 근무일 14일간 2차로 진행된다. 감사원은 1차 실지감사 결과에 따라 필요한 경우, 감사 범위를 넓히거나 실지감사를 추가로 할 수도 있다고 했다. 이는 통상적인 감사보다 인력과 시간을 3~4배 투입하는 것이다.)

Regarding the shortage of ballots during the June 3 local elections, the BAI said it would examine ▲the budget formulation and execution for ballot printing and ▲whether the ballot printing contracts were properly conducted. It also announced it would verify ▲whether the purchase and management of election materials and building leases are appropriate, and ▲whether the estimation of election expenses, such as personnel costs, and budget adjustments are proper. However, due to the Constitutional Court's decision prohibiting job inspections of the NEC, direct investigations into areas such as voter list management for the June 3 local elections, deployment of election personnel, election management, and ballot redistribution are not possible. (감사원은 이를 통해 12가지 사항을 중점적으로 들여다보겠다고 했다. 감사원은 “투표용지 인쇄와 계약이 포함된 선거 관련 예산·편성 집행 실태와 국민적 의혹이 큰 사항, 선관위 자정 노력 검증에 필요한 사항 등을 점검해, 선관위에 대한 국민 의혹의 해소 방안을 마련하겠다”고 했다.)

The BAI also stated it would review the appropriateness of various allowances paid by the NEC to its commissioners and employees, including ▲attendance allowances, special incentive payments, education allowances, agenda review allowances, management allowances, and bonuses. Amid controversy over NEC staff taking overseas trips to destinations like the Maldives under the guise of election observation, the BAI said it would also look into ▲official overseas travel and expense reimbursements. Regarding issues related to overseas election officers dispatched to diplomatic missions abroad to manage overseas voting, the BAI stated it would examine this through a review of ▲the expenses and allowances for managing overseas voter elections. (6·3지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해서는 ▲투표용지 인쇄 예산 편성·집행과 ▲투표용지 인쇄 계약이 적정하게 이뤄졌는지를 살펴보겠다고 했다. ▲선거 물품 구매·관리와 건물 임차는 적정한지, ▲인건비 등의 선거 경비소요 추계와 예산 조정은 적정한지도 확인하겠다고 했다. 다만 헌재 결정으로 선관위에 대한 직무 감찰이 금지돼, 6·3지방선거 선거인명부 관리나 선거 인력 배치, 선거 관리, 투표용지 재배분 등은 직접 조사가 불가하다.)

In connection with allegations that the NEC violated the State Contracts Act by signing most contracts through negotiated procedures, the BAI decided to investigate ▲whether the unit prices for negotiated contracts are appropriate, and whether there were practices such as favoritism in contract allocation, contract splitting, contracts with related parties, or preferential treatment. (감사원은 ▲출석 수당, 특별정려금, 교육 수당, 안건 검토 수당, 관리 수당, 격려금 등 선관위가 위원과 직원에게 주는 각종 수당도 적정한지 살펴보겠다고 했다. 선관위 직원들이 해외 선거 참관을 명목으로 몰디브 등 지역에 외유성 출장을 다녀온 것으로 드러나 논란이 된 가운데, ▲공무 국외 출장과 여비 집행도 들여다보겠다고 했다. 선관위가 재외국민 투표 관리를 명목으로 재외공관에 파견하는 재외선거관 관련 문제는 ▲재외국민 선거 관리 경비와 수당 지급 검사를 통해 살펴보겠다고 했다.)

The BAI further stated it would inspect the NEC's ▲operation of the Fair Election Support Team and the execution of daily wages for temporary workers, as well as ▲the execution of business promotion expenses and overtime meal expenses. It also said it would examine ▲whether the NEC has properly implemented corrective measures pointed out in past BAI audits. Additionally, it will check ▲whether election costs paid to candidates whose elections were invalidated are being recovered. (선관위가 국가계약법을 어기고 대다수 계약을 수의계약으로 체결했다는 의혹과 관련해서는 ▲수의계약 단가 산정은 적정한지, 일감 몰아주기나 쪼개기 계약, 특수관계자와의 계약, 특혜 등은 없었는지를 살펴보기로 했다.)

item.title: Lee Byung-tae, Pressured to Resign: "Choosing a Life of Honor Over Profit" (사퇴 압박 받는 이병태 “이익 대신 명예를 위한 삶 선택”)
item.description:
Lee Byung-tae, Pressured to Resign: "Choosing a Life of Honor Over Profit" (사퇴 압박 받는 이병태 “이익 대신 명예를 위한 삶 선택”)

Lee Byung-tae, deputy chair of the Regulatory Reform Committee under the direct authority of the president, on the 6th referenced the English politician and thinker Thomas More (1478-1535), stating, "I have chosen a life that picks 'honor (conscience)' over 'profit (life and power).'" (이병태 대통령 직속 규제합리화위원회 부위원장이 6일 영국 정치가이자 사상가인 토마스 모어(1478~1535)를 언급하며 “‘이익(목숨과 권력)’ 대신 ‘명예(양심)’를 택한 삶을 선택했다”고 했다.)

In a Facebook post titled 'The Cost of Upholding One's Beliefs,' the deputy chair explained, "He refused to the end to align with (Henry VIII) because it conflicted with his faith and moral conscience." This comes amid warnings from the presidential office over his criticism of the Baejae High School baseball team's disciplinary actions, and a barrage of pressure from the ruling party for his resignation, signaling his determination not to waver in his stance. (이 부위원장은 이날 페이스북에 ‘신념을 지키는 비용’이라는 제목의 글을 올리고 “자신의 신앙과 도덕적 양심에 어긋난다는 이유로 끝까지 (헨리 8세에) 동조하지 않았다”며 이같이 밝혔다. 배재고 야구부 징계를 비판했다는 이유로 청와대가 엄중 경고를 하고 여권에서 전방위적 사퇴 압박이 쏟아지는 가운데, 자신의 뜻을 굽히지 않겠다는 뜻을 밝힌 것으로 보인다.)

The deputy chair noted, "More was a renowned English legal scholar and literary figure who rose to the highest office of Lord Chancellor under Henry VIII. When Henry VIII broke from the Catholic Church over his divorce issue and sought to become the religious head of England himself, Thomas More refused to the end to go along with it because it went against his faith and moral conscience." (이 부위원장은 “무어는 영국의 저명한 법학자이자 문학가로, 헨리 8세 밑에서 최고 관직인 대법관까지 오른 인물”이라며 “헨리 8세가 이혼 문제로 가톨릭교회와 결별하고 스스로 영국의 종교적 수장이 되려 하자, 토마스 모어는 자신의 신앙과 도덕적 양심에 어긋난다는 이유로 끝까지 이에 동조하지 않았다”고 했다.)

He continued, "Eventually, he fell out of favor with the king, was imprisoned in the Tower of London for treason, and was executed by beheading in 1535. Just before his execution, he left a principled last words: 'I die the king's good servant, but God's first.'" He added that More's work 'Utopia' showed a lack of understanding of capitalist markets, saying, "Though he may not have grasped the positive functions of a market economy coupled with the rule of law, he chose a life of 'honor (conscience)' over 'profit (life and power),' just as he said." (이어 “결국 왕의 눈밖에 나 반역죄로 런던탑에 갇혔고, 1535년 단두대에서 처형당했다”며 “처형 직전 그는 ‘나는 왕의 좋은 종이기 전에, 하나님의 착한 종으로 죽는다’라는 지조 있는 유언을 남겼다”고 했다. 이어 토마스 모어가 쓴 ‘유토피아’를 보면 자본주의 시장에 대한 이해가 없었다며 “비록 법치주의와 결합된 시장경제의 순기능을 이해하지는 못했어도 자신이 한 말처럼 ‘이익(목숨과 권력)’ 대신 ‘명예(양심)’를 택한 삶을 선택했다”고 했다.)

item.title: Song Young-gil: "Turning Incheon's Crisis into Opportunity... The Only One with Experience as a Metropolitan Government Head" (송영길 “인천의 위기를 기회로...광역자치단체장 경험 유일”)
item.description:
Song Young-gil: "Turning Incheon's Crisis into Opportunity... The Only One with Experience as a Metropolitan Government Head" (송영길 “인천의 위기를 기회로...광역자치단체장 경험 유일”)

Rep. Song Young-gil, a candidate for the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea, stated on the 6th that he is the only one among the party leadership contenders with experience as a head of a metropolitan government, having turned Incheon's crisis into an opportunity. Leveraging his experience as Incheon Mayor and party leader, Rep. Song is expected to emphasize that he is 'the right person to lead a party capable of reclaiming power'. Former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok is set to make his official declaration of candidacy in Gwangju, Jeonnam, on the same day, being the first among the party leadership contenders to do so. <<> In a Facebook post on the same day, Rep. Song said, "Yesterday, I was given a meaningful gathering to celebrate my election in my district by 'Michuholhoe,' a group of former senior officials from the Incheon City Government," adding, "Among the mentioned candidates for the Democratic Party leadership, I am the only one with experience in a metropolitan government." He continued, "When I took office in 2010, Incheon City was in financial hardship with 7 trillion won in debt and nearly 1 billion won in daily interest. I was the only opposition party mayor in the Seoul metropolitan area at the age of 47," and said, "Because you stood with me during those tough times, I was able to lead Incheon without wavering." <<> Rep. Song also said, "I successfully managed Incheon on the verge of bankruptcy and turned the crisis into an opportunity," adding, "Everyone agreed that the experience of creating a global city like Incheon is a significant asset that can support the success of the Lee Jae-myung government as a party leader." <<> Former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, on the morning of the same day, paid respects at the National 5·18 Democratic Cemetery Memorial Tower in Unjeong-dong, Buk-gu, Gwangju, honoring the May spirits by offering flowers and incense, and then visited the graves of martyr Yoon Sang-won and martyr Park Hyun-sook. <<> Former PM Kim wrote in the guestbook, "Now May 18 is beyond history, it is the future." After finishing his tribute, he plans to move to Jeonil Building 245 in Dong-gu to officially declare his candidacy for the leadership of the Democratic Party. <<> This declaration of candidacy is the earliest among the party leadership contenders, originally scheduled to take place near the Gwangju military airfield. However, due to weather conditions, the venue was changed to Jeonil Building 245. It is reported that Democratic Party lawmakers supporting former PM Kim will join the declaration ceremony. <<> Another contender, former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae, responded to Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Yong-min's announcement of not running for party leadership by calling it a "deeply agonized decision" and reiterated the full abolition of supplementary investigation powers. Rep. Kim, who had consistently emphasized the full abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers, had been speculated to run for leadership but declared his non-candidacy via social media the previous day. <<> Former Rep. Jeong, in a late Facebook post on the 5th, stated, "I will join forces with Rep. Kim Yong-min to complete the prosecution reform as Rep. Kim envisions," emphasizing the "full abolition of supplementary investigation powers." However, pro-Lee leadership contenders like former PM Kim and Rep. Song have made no particular comments on Rep. Kim's non-candidacy. (더불어민주당 당권 주자인 송영길 의원은 6일 당 대표 후보 가운데 유일한 광역자지단체장 출신으로 인천의 위기를 기회로 전환했다고 언급했다. 인천시장, 당 대표 경험을 앞세워 송 의원은 ‘재집권 할 수 있는 수권 정당 대표의 적임자’를 강조할 것으로 보인다. 김민석 전 총리는 이날 전남광주에서 당권 주자 중 처음으로 공식 출마 선언을 할 예정이다.)

item.title: “Starting Tomorrow, the National ‘Gag Law’ Takes Effect”... People Power Party Leadership Appears at Supreme Council Wearing Black Masks (“내일부터 국민 입틀막법 시행”...국힘 지도부, 최고위에 검은 마스크 쓰고 등장)
item.description:
“Starting Tomorrow, the National ‘Gag Law’ Takes Effect”... People Power Party Leadership Appears at Supreme Council Wearing Black Masks (“내일부터 국민 입틀막법 시행”...국힘 지도부, 최고위에 검은 마스크 쓰고 등장)

As the revised Act on Promotion of Information and Communications Network Utilization and Information Protection, spearheaded by the Democratic Party of Korea late last year, takes effect on the 7th, People Power Party Representative Jang Dong-hyuk stated at the party’s Supreme Council meeting on the 6th, “We will block the national gag law.” (작년 말 더불어민주당 주도로 개정된 정보통신망법이 7일 시행되는 가운데 국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 6일 당 최고위원회의에서 “국민 입틀막법을 막아내겠다”고 했다.)

The People Power Party leadership all entered the Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly in Yeouido, Seoul, wearing black masks. Representative Jang said, “Starting tomorrow, the so-called gag law takes effect,” and added, “Before beginning today’s Supreme Council meeting, we entered wearing black masks to highlight the injustice of this law.” (국민의힘 지도부는 이날 서울 여의도 국회에서 열린 최고위원회의에 일제히 검은색 마스크를 끼고 입장했다. 장 대표는 “내일부터 이른바 입틀막법이 시행된다”며 “오늘 최고위원회의 시작하기 전에 저희들이 이 법의 부당함을 알리기 위해서 검정색 마스크를 쓰고 입장을 했다”고 했다.)

In his opening remarks, Representative Jang criticized the revised Information and Communications Network Act, saying, “Ahead of the withdrawal of the indictment (against President Lee), this aims to silence not only legacy media but also YouTubers.” He further stated, “If the government arbitrarily labels something as fake news, the penalty surcharge is 1 billion won,” and added, “Given the track record of the Lee Jae-myung administration so far, arbitrarily slapping a ‘fake news’ label is no big deal. They will go ahead with this reckless act.” (장 대표는 이날 모두발언에서 개정 정보통신망법에 대해 “(이 대통령) 공소 취소를 앞두고 기존 레거시 언론은 물론 유튜버들 입까지 모두 틀어막겠다는 것”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “정부가 아무렇게나 가짜뉴스 딱지만 붙이면 과징금이 10억원”이라며 “그동안 이재명 정부가 해왔던 행태를 보면 마음대로 가짜뉴스 딱지를 붙이는 건 일도 아니다. 그 무모한 일을 하고야 말 것이다”라고 했다.)

Representative Jang claimed, “In the end, they will gag every citizen,” and “Comments opposing Lee Jae-myung will completely disappear online.” He continued, “If they blind the people’s eyes, plug their ears, and gag their mouths, the end result will be the completion of Lee Jae-myung’s dictatorship,” and “They will eventually push for a constitutional amendment to allow reelection.” (장 대표는 “결국 모든 국민의 입을 틀어막고 말 것”이라며 “이재명 반대하는 댓글은 온라인에서 완전히 사라질 것”이라고 했다. 이어 “국민의 눈을 가리고 귀를 막고 입까지 틀어막으면 그 끝은 바로 이재명 독재의 완성”이라며 “결국 헌법 개정해서 연임하겠다고 나설 것”이라고 했다.)

He added, “The People Power Party will revise the Information and Communications Network Act again to protect citizens’ freedoms and push for proper prosecution reform to safeguard the people,” and “We will create laws that protect the people and block laws that protect power.” (그러면서 “국민의힘은 정보통신망법을 다시 개정해서 국민의 자유를 지키고 올바른 검찰 개혁안을 추진해서 국민을 보호하겠다”며 “국민을 지키는 법을 만들고 권력을 지키는 법은 막아내겠다”고 했다.)

People Power Party Floor Leader Jeong Jeom-sik also said, “Already, netizens are suffering from censorship phobia, saying things like ‘I’m scared to write comments now’ or ‘From tomorrow, I’ll have to use indirect speech,’” and “It’s telling that even pro-government groups like the People’s Solidarity for Participatory Democracy and the Minbyun lawyers’ association opposed this bad law, fearing it would shrink the public discourse.” (국민의힘 정점식 원내대표도 “벌써부터 누리꾼들은 ‘이제 댓글 쓰기도 겁난다’, ‘내일부터는 간접 화법을 써야 한다’며 검열 포비아에 시달리고 있다”며 “오죽하면 참여연대 민변 같은 친여성향 단체까지 공론의 장 위축을 우려하며 이 악법을 반대했겠나”라고 했다.)

He added, “Moreover, this online gag law forces large-scale online platform operators to take measures such as deleting or blocking the distribution of such information,” and “Platforms will engage in prior censorship to curry favor with the authorities, and users will be trapped in self-censorship out of fear of being sued or reported.” (그는 “더구나 온라인 입틀막법은 대규모 온라인 플랫폼 사업자에게 해당 정보의 삭제 및 차단 등 유통 방지 업무를 강제한다”며 “플랫폼은 권력의 눈치를 보며 사전 검열을 할 것이고 이용자는 고소·고발이 두려워 자기 검열에 갇힐 것”이라고 했다.)

He further stated, “If the Democratic Party’s history of falsehood, manipulation, and incitement had each been punished under the ‘gag law,’ they would have had to pay damages and even sell off their party headquarters to end up on the streets,” and “The irony of history is that the Democratic Party, which has profited handsomely from spreading false information, now says it will crack down on falsehoods and suppress the constitutionally guaranteed freedom of expression.” (그러면서 “만약 더불어민주당의 허위 조작 선동 역사가 하나하나 ‘입틀막법’으로 처벌받았다면 손해배상금 납부하다가 당사까지 팔고 거리로 내앉았을 것”이라며 “허위 사실 유포로 짭짤한 이익을 챙겨왔던 민주당이 이제는 허위 사실을 단속하겠다며 헌법이 보장한 표현의 자유를 억압하겠다니 역사의 아이러니”라고 했다.)

The revised Information and Communications Network Act, passed by the National Assembly in December last year, takes effect on the 7th and is also referred to as the “7/7 Law.” At the time, the People Power Party opposed it as “state-led censorship” and even staged a filibuster (unlimited debate), but the Democratic Party pushed it through. The law stipulates that those who distribute “false or manipulated information” on online media can be liable for up to five times the amount of damages, and those who maliciously and repeatedly circulate such information can face a penalty surcharge of up to 1 billion won. For online platforms with more than 1 million daily users, such as Naver and Kakao, there is also an obligation to delete and block such “false or manipulated information.” (작년 12월 국회를 통과한 개정 정통망법은 7일부터 시행돼 ’7·7법‘이라고도 불린다. 당시 국민의힘이 “국가 주도 검열”이라며 필리버스터(무제한 토론)까지 했지만 민주당이 밀어붙였다. 이 법은 인터넷 언론 등 온라인상에서 ‘허위·조작 정보’를 유통하는 경우 손해액의 최대 5배까지 배상하게 하고, 악의적·반복적으로 유포한 경우 최대 10억원의 과징금을 부과하는 내용이다. 네이버·카카오 등 하루 100만명 이상 이용하는 온라인 플랫폼의 경우 ‘허위·조작 정보’를 삭제하고 차단할 의무도 있다.)

item.title: "Three Major Mega Projects Must Receive Bipartisan Support... People Power Party, Stop Playing Politics" (與 “3대 메가 프로젝트 초당적 지원해야…국힘, 발목잡기 그만”)
item.description:
"Three Major Mega Projects Must Receive Bipartisan Support... People Power Party, Stop Playing Politics" (與 “3대 메가 프로젝트 초당적 지원해야…국힘, 발목잡기 그만”)

Democratic Party of Korea Acting Leader and Floor Leader Han Byeong-do stated on the 6th, "The three major mega projects are national strategic initiatives for a century-long legacy and a task of our era that the government, National Assembly, local governments, and businesses must unite as one team to ensure success. What politics should do is not to trip things up, but to provide bipartisan support." (더불어민주당 한병도 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 6일 “3대 메가 프로젝트는 100년 대계의 국가 전략 사업이자 정부와 국회, 지방정부와 기업이 원팀으로 똘똘 뭉쳐 반드시 성공시켜야 할 시대적 과제”라며 “정치가 해야 할 일은 발목 잡기가 아니라 초당적 지원”이라고 했다.)

Acting Leader Han made these remarks during the party's supreme council meeting, saying, "I urge the People Power Party to stop playing politics and join this bold journey." (한 대행은 이날 당 최고위원회의에서 “국민의힘이 발목 잡기를 그만두고 이 담대한 여정에 동참할 것을 촉구한다”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

Han added, "We will further strengthen the support framework for the three major mega projects in line with the government's pace of execution. We will expand the support task force for these projects into a special committee directly under the acting leader, establishing a comprehensive support system to oversee legislation, budget, and regulatory innovation." (한 대행은 “정부의 실행 속도에 맞춰 3대 메가 프로젝트 지원 체계를 한층 더 강화하겠다”며 “3대 메가 프로젝트 지원 TF를 대표 직무대행 직속 특별위원회로 확대해 입법과 예산, 규제 혁신을 총괄하는 전반적 지원 체계를 구축하겠다”고 했다.)

He continued, "Abroad, many countries offered greater support and sought to attract investments from our companies, but our companies chose domestic investment considering national competitiveness. Yet, the People Power Party is even using this to stoke regional sentiments and turn it into grounds for political strife." (그는 그러면서 “해외에서 우리 기업에 더 많은 지원을 해주겠다며 앞다퉈 투자 유치를 타진했지만, 기업들은 국가 경쟁력을 고려해 국내 투자를 결단했다”며 “그런데 국민의힘은 이조차도 지역감정을 동원해 정쟁의 근거로 삼고 있다”고 했다.)

Regarding criticism from some in the People Power Party who called for a parliamentary investigation and a special counsel probe into the three major mega projects, Han said, "Would the public accept turning corporate investment decisions and national growth strategies into targets for parliamentary investigations and special counsel probes? Right now, countries around the world are staking their national fortunes and waging all-out wars in the high-tech industrial competition surrounding semiconductors and AI." He added, "We will push ahead without delay with follow-up legislation and budget support, including the special law for the mega special zones." (한 대행은 국민의힘 일각에서 3대 메가 프로젝트에 대한 국정조사와 특검 필요성을 제기하며 비판한 것에 대해 “기업의 투자 결단과 국가의 성장 전략을 국정조사와 특검으로 몰아가는 것을 국민이 납득하겠나”라며 “지금 세계 각국은 반도체와 AI를 둘러싼 첨단 산업 경쟁에 국가의 명운을 걸고 총력전을 벌이고 있다”고 했다. 이어 “메가특구 특별법을 비롯한 후속 입법과 예산 지원을 차질 없이 추진하겠다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, Han announced regarding the shortage of ballot papers, "We will submit a special counsel bill this week to uncover the truth and punish those responsible." He urged the People Power Party, saying, "To eliminate all political considerations in this special counsel probe, a third-party recommendation method is more realistic and fair. Insisting only on the opposition party's unilateral recommendation is not about uncovering the truth, but merely a claim for political strife." (한편 한 대행은 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해 “진상 규명과 책임자 처벌을 위해 이번 주에 특검 법안을 제출하겠다”고 했다. 그는 국민의힘을 향해 “이번 특검에서 정치적 고려를 모두 배제하려면 제3자 추천 방식이 더 현실적이고 공정하다”며 “야당 단독 추천만을 고집하는 것은 진상 규명이 아니고 정쟁을 위한 주장에 불과하다”고 했다.)

item.title: Ministry of National Defense Abruptly Postpones Announced Basic Plan for Integrating Service Academies Two Hours Before Scheduled Briefing (국방부, 사관학교 통합 기본계획 발표 2시간 전 돌연 연기)
item.description:
Ministry of National Defense Abruptly Postpones Announced Basic Plan for Integrating Service Academies Two Hours Before Scheduled Briefing (국방부, 사관학교 통합 기본계획 발표 2시간 전 돌연 연기)

The Ministry of National Defense had planned to explain the government’s basic plan for integrating the Army, Navy, and Air Force service academies on the 6th, but postponed the briefing about two hours before it was scheduled to take place. (국방부가 6일 육·해·공군 사관학교 통합 추진을 위한 정부의 기본계획을 설명하기로 했지만 브리핑 약 2시간 전 이를 연기했다.)

The ministry had notified reporters the previous day (the 5th) that Minister of National Defense Ahn Kyu-baek would hold a briefing at the ministry’s office in Yongsan-gu, Seoul, to announce the basic plan for establishing the ROK Armed Forces Service Academy. However, about two hours before the scheduled briefing time, the ministry informed the press corps covering the ministry that the event would be postponed. (국방부는 이날 오전 서울 용산구 국방부 청사에서 안규백 국방부 장관 브리핑을 통해 국군사관학교 창설 기본계획을 발표할 예정이라고 전날(5일) 공지했다. 하지만 브리핑 예정 시간을 약 2시간 앞두고 이를 순연한다고 국방부 출입기자단에 공지했다.)

The postponement is understood to have occurred because Minister Ahn, who was set to personally deliver the briefing, was called to attend a “Public-Private Joint Inspection Meeting on Mega Projects” held at the presidential office that morning. It is reported that the presidential office urgently requested Minister Ahn’s participation in the inspection meeting. (브리핑에 직접 나설 예정이던 안규백 장관이 이날 오전 청와대에서 개최되는 ' 메가프로젝트 민관합동 점검회의’에 참석하게 되면서 일정을 연기한 것으로 알려졌다. 청와대가 급하게 안 장관의 점검회의 참석을 요청한 것으로 전해졌다.)

The ministry is expected to reschedule the briefing on the establishment of the ROK Armed Forces Service Academy after Minister Ahn accompanies President Lee Jae-myung, who is attending the NATO summit in Ankara, Turkey, on the 7th and 8th. (국방부는 안 장관이 7∼8일 튀르키예 앙카라에서 열리는 북대서양조약기구(NATO) 정상회의에 참석하는 이재명 대통령을 수행한 이후 국군사관학교 창설 관련 브리핑을 다시 추진할 계획인 것으로 전해졌다.)

NATO has planned a separate working dinner for defense ministers from member and partner countries during this summit. According to the NATO website, Minister Ahn, along with defense ministers from the IP4 nations (Indo-Pacific partner countries: South Korea, Japan, Australia, and New Zealand), has been invited to this event. (나토는 이번 정상회의 기간 회원국 및 파트너국 국방장관들을 대상으로 별도의 업무만찬을 계획하고 있다. 나토 홈페이지에 따르면 안 장관을 비롯한 IP4(한국·일본·호주·뉴질랜드 등 인도·태평양 지역 파트너 4개국) 국방장관들도 이 자리에 초청됐다.)

The Ministry of National Defense is pursuing a plan to establish the “ROK Armed Forces Service Academy” to integrate and select cadets for the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies. The plan envisions first- and second-year students receiving common education together, while third- and fourth-year students choose a service branch for specialized military education. In this regard, Minister Ahn stated at a meeting of key military commanders on the 1st, “The expertise of the Army, Navy, and Air Force must be preserved, but it should not become a ‘silo’ between the services.” In an earlier directive to the military, he also said, “Admission scores for service academies are continuously declining,” and added, “We need to expand the scale of the academies to create a ‘bigger vessel’ for nurturing national talent.” (국방부는 ‘국군사관학교’를 창설해 육·해·공군 사관학교 생도들을 통합 선발하는 방안을 추진 중이다. 1·2학년엔 함께 공통 교육을, 3·4학년엔 군을 선택해 군별 특화 전공교육을 받도록 한다는 구상이다. 안 장관은 이와 관련 지난 1일 전군주요지휘관회의에서 “육·해·공군의 전문성은 반드시 지켜져야 하지만 군 간의 ‘칸막이’가 돼서는 안 된다”고 했다. 이에 앞서 보낸 전군 지휘서신에서는 “사관학교 입학 성적은 계속 낮아지고 있다”며 “사관학교의 규모를 키워 국가 인재 양성을 위한 ‘커다란 그릇’을 만들어야 한다”고도 했다.)

However, opposition voices from the political opposition, alumni associations of the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies, and retired generals are growing stronger. The joint alumni association of the three service academies plans to hold a “Rally Against the Merger of Service Academies and Relocation of the Korea Military Academy” in front of the National Assembly building at 11 a.m. on the 8th. (하지만 야권과 육·해·공군사관학교 총동창회, 예비역 장성 등 사이에서는 최근 반발 목소리가 거세지고 있다. 육·해·공군사관학교 총동문회는 오는 8일 오전 11시 국회 본관 앞에서 ‘사관학교 통폐합·육사 이전 반대 궐기대회’를 열 예정이다.)

Given this situation, the Ministry of National Defense abruptly decided to explain the “basic plan” through a ministerial briefing, only to cancel it a day later. A retired military official commented, “It will be difficult to avoid criticism that the integration of the service academies is being rushed and poorly handled.” (이런 상황에서 국방부가 돌연 장관 브리핑을 통해 ‘기본계획’을 설명하겠다고 했다가 하루만에 취소한 것이다. 예비역 군 관계자는 “사관학교 통합 문제를 졸속으로 추진하고 있다는 비판을 피하기 어렵다”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee: "Mega Projects Are a Race for Speed... Even If You Can't Cooperate with Historical Tasks, You Shouldn't Obstruct Them" (李 “메가 프로젝트는 속도전...역사적 과제에 협조 못해도 방해는 말아야”)
item.description:
Lee: "Mega Projects Are a Race for Speed... Even If You Can't Cooperate with Historical Tasks, You Shouldn't Obstruct Them" (李 “메가 프로젝트는 속도전...역사적 과제에 협조 못해도 방해는 말아야”)

President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 6th regarding the three mega projects, including the 'Honam Semiconductor' initiative, "An all-out competition affecting the nation's fate is underway," adding, "Victory will be decided by who is faster. Truly, speed is all that matters." The president made these remarks during a public-private joint review meeting on the three mega projects held at the Blue House, saying, "The government will do its utmost." <<> Addressing simultaneous criticisms labeling the construction of four semiconductor fabrication plants (fabs) in the Honam region as both 'regional discrimination' and an 'unfeasible project,' President Lee responded, "Pick just one," adding, "South Korea is trying to create new opportunities. I hope people at least refrain from major obstruction, even if they can't fully cooperate." <<> President Lee noted, "Some protest, questioning why [the project] goes only to one region [under the premise that it's possible], yet with the same mouth, they also call it 'a scam,' 'impossible,' or 'just an event.'" He continued, "Is this the proper attitude for public figures managing the country's affairs? Either criticize it under the premise that it's impossible, or point out the imbalance under the premise that it's possible—choose one." He added, "In any case, I hope people won't obstruct things in this manner." <<> The core of the three mega projects announced by the government is the construction of four semiconductor fabs in the Honam region, with Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix investing 800 trillion won. The government has declared it will complete all four fabs within President Lee's term. The president's remarks that day were a response to backlash from other regions over the concentration of investment in Honam, and criticism from the opposition—who argue it's impossible to build the four fabs within his term—telling them, "The backlash and criticism contradict each other, so pick one." <<> Reasons cited for the difficulty of constructing the four fabs within President Lee's remaining term of about four years include the time required to secure land, and the uncertainty in securing the electricity and water essential for the semiconductor process. <<> In this regard, President Lee said during the meeting, "The land acquisition process goes through negotiation procedures, and if there are 'holdouts' who resist, it takes an enormous amount of time for negotiations. Only at the end does the compulsory acquisition process start. [This time], start the negotiation acquisition and compulsory acquisition procedures simultaneously." He ordered the application of the compulsory acquisition process—typically the final step—from the very beginning to minimize the time needed to secure land. <<> Regarding securing electricity and water, President Lee also stated, "Don't wait until other procedures are completed for the electricity and water issues either; proactively secure them under the premise that they will be needed. Once electricity and water are in place, other companies might move in." He added, "Electricity in particular will be an issue, and a swift resolution is most important. Companies are very concerned about base power supply; it would be good to proactively resolve that issue as well." (이재명 대통령은 6일 ‘호남 반도체’ 등 3대 메가 프로젝트에 대해 “국운이 걸린 총력 경쟁이 벌어지고 있다”며 “누가 더 빠르냐로 결판난다. 그야말로 오직 속도전이 중요하다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 열린 3대 메가 프로젝트 민관 합동 점검 회의에서 “정부는 할 수 있는 최대치를 할 것”이라며 이같이 말했다.)

item.title: Cho Kuk now takes aim at “Kim Manager”... “Questioning the use of ‘5 minutes 23 seconds’” (조국, 이번엔 ‘김부장’ 겨냥... “5분 23초 사용 의문”)
item.description:
Cho Kuk now takes aim at “Kim Manager”... “Questioning the use of ‘5 minutes 23 seconds’” (조국, 이번엔 ‘김부장’ 겨냥... “5분 23초 사용 의문”)

On the 6th, former leader of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, Cho Kuk, commented on a scene from the original webtoon of SBS drama “Kim Manager,” stating that “unfair misunderstandings about Ilbe (a Korean online community) should be corrected,” but added, “the reason for using ‘5.23’ is questionable.” May 23rd is the anniversary of the death of former President Roh Moo-hyun. (조국혁신당 조국 전 대표가 6일 SBS 드라마 ‘김부장’ 원작 웹툰의 한 장면을 두고 “억울한 일베 오해는 바로잡아야 한다”면서도 “5.23 사용 이유는 의문”이라고 했다. 5월 23일은 노무현 전 대통령 서거일이다.)

On his Facebook that day, Cho wrote, “The Ilbe culture of adding ‘no’ at the end of interrogative sentences must be eradicated, but unfair Ilbe misunderstandings should be corrected.” This was in response to some YouTube channels raising Ilbe suspicions against Park Tae-joon, the original webtoon author of the drama “Kim Manager,” claiming that in his earlier work “Lookism,” “the sign behind the speech bubble reads ‘Rock Owling,’ which evokes ‘Owl Rock,’ the place where former President Roh Moo-hyun passed away.” Cho corrected that this was a misunderstanding. (조 전 대표는 이날 자신의 페이스북에 “의문문 끝에 ‘노’를 붙여 사용하는 일베 문화는 근절되어야 하지만, 억울한 일베 오해는 바로잡아야 한다”고 썼다. 일부 유튜브에서 드라마 ‘김부장’ 웹툰 원작자인 박태준 작가가 과거 작품 ‘외모지상주의’에서 “말풍선 뒤 간판이 ‘Rock Owling’이라고 적혀 있다”며 “노무현 전 대통령이 서거한 장소인 부엉이바위를 떠올리게 한다”고 일베 의혹을 제기한 것에 대해 오해를 바로잡은 것이다.)

He introduced an article by Park In-ha, a cartoon critic and chairman of the Seoul Webtoon Academy, who examined the original work and confirmed that it reads “hanwon rock bowling” (Hanwon Rock Bowling Alley), not “Rock Owling,” and stated, “This unfair Ilbe accusation should be corrected.” (그는 원작을 보니 ‘Rock Owling’이 아니라 ‘hanwon rock bowling’(한원 락 볼링장)이라고 그려져 있다는 만화 평론가 박인하 서울웹툰아카데미 이사장의 글을 소개하며 “억울한 일베는 바로잡아야 한다”고 했다.)

However, he added, “The use of ‘5.23’ remains questionable.” Online, there have been Ilbe suspicions regarding a scene in “Lookism” where the protagonist looks at a stopwatch and says “5 minutes 23 seconds,” with some alleging it alludes to May 23rd, the date of former President Roh’s death. (그러면서도 “5.23 사용 이유는 의문”이라고 했다. 온라인에서는 ‘외모지상주의’ 주인공이 초시계를 보며 ‘5분 23초’라고 말하는 장면을 두고 “노 전 대통령의 서거일인 5월 23일을 연상시키는 것 아니냐”는 ‘일베 의혹’이 나왔었다.)

The previous day, Cho stirred controversy by referencing the so-called “Ilbe tone of speech.” On Facebook, he argued for distinguishing between the Gyeongsang dialect and the use of “no” by Ilbe users, claiming that “Ilbe mechanically attaches ‘no’ to the end of standard speech.” This came in response to recent controversy over a comment by Wonhee, a member of girl group RIIZE, who said “museopno” (scary), sparking so-called Ilbe suspicions. (조 전 대표는 전날에는 이른바 ‘일베 말투’를 언급해 논란이 됐다. 그는 페이스북에 “일베는 표준말 뒤에 기계적으로 ‘노’를 붙여 사용한다”며 영남 사투리와 일베 이용자들이 쓰는 ‘노’ 사용을 구별해야 한다는 취지로 주장했다. 최근 걸그룹 리센느 멤버 원이가 “무섭노”라고 발언해 이른바 ‘일베’ 논란이 나온 데 따른 것이다.)

As criticism of his remarks grew, Cho posted again that day, writing, “Many teenagers and young adults use ‘no’ at the end of interrogative sentences without being Ilbe users. Bringing this up might be seen as a cowardly attempt to lecture the younger generation like an old-timer.” He added, “I completely disagree. Whether using ‘no’ in interrogative sentences aligns with the Gyeongsang dialect grammar is beside the point. It is clearly a wrongful act that mocks and belittles the late former President Roh Moo-hyun, and I believe this must be made clear. Young people should also know that using ‘no’ in interrogative sentences is a form of hate speech and should refrain from it.” (조 전 대표는 자신의 글에 대해 비판이 커지자 이날 재차 글을 올리고 “많은 10대, 20대들이 일베가 아님에도 의문문에 ‘노’를 붙여 사용하고 있는 바, 이 문제를 제기하는 것은 10-20대를 훈계하는 꼰대짓이라는 비겁한 주장이 있나 보다”라고 했다. 그는 “전혀 동의할 수 없다. 의문문에 ‘노’를 붙여 사용하는 것은 경상도 말 용법에 맞나 맞지 않나가 아니라 고 노무현 대통령을 조롱하고 폄훼하는 잘못된 행위임을 분명히 알려야 한다고 생각한다”며 “청년들도 의문문에 ‘노’를 붙여 사용하는 것이 잘못된 혐오표현임을 알고 더 이상 사용하지 말아야 한다”고 했다.)

On the same day, Lee Jun-seok, leader of the People Power Party, posted on Facebook, saying, “Former leader Cho Kuk has suddenly started singing the ‘death march’ against the Gyeongsang dialect.” He expressed concern, “A promising entertainer who has grown rapidly by fully embracing the local color of their hometown as a new form of content might, due to Cho’s thoughtless criticism, lose their unique identity, whether voluntarily or involuntarily.” (이준석 대표는 이날 페이스북에 글을 올리고 “조국 전 대표가 뜬금없이 경상도 사투리를 향해 죽창가를 부르기 시작했다”며 “고향의 지역색을 오롯이 드러내며 새로운 형태의 콘텐츠로 빠르게 성장한 전도유망한 연예인이 조국 전 대표의 몰상식한 타박으로 자의 또는 타의에 따라 고유의 색채를 잃을까 걱정”이라고 했다.)

He continued, “I hope they don’t force the younger generation to treat history with emotion like themselves, making them avoid using the word ‘no,’ the ending of the Gyeongsang dialect, as a taboo.” Lee added, “Most of the 20-somethings who will lead our society in the future have not experienced President Roh’s politics. I hope we don’t expect, force, or instill in them the sensitivity, memory, and solemnity toward President Roh beyond what they learn from books.” (그러면서 “젊은 세대에게 본인들처럼 감성으로 역사를 다루라고 강요하며 경상도 사투리의 끝말인 ‘노’라는 글자를 피휘(避諱)하게 만들지 않았으면 좋겠다”고 적었다. 이어 “앞으로 우리 사회를 이끌어갈 20대는 대부분 노무현 대통령의 정치를 경험하지 못했다”며 “그들에게 책에서 배운 것 이상의 노무현 대통령에 대한 감수성과 기억, 엄숙함을 기대하거나 강요하거나 주입하지 않았으면 좋겠다”고 했다.)

Lee stated, “Even if someone uses President Roh as a meme with the intention of mockery, even if it’s not dignified behavior, I think it’s time to stop lumping an entire generation together and accusing them of being Ilbe because of it.” He added, “I hope now President Roh can be remembered as an ordinary former president, not a sanctuary. I believe his final words, asking to leave just a small stone, convey that meaning.” (이 대표는 “누군가가 혹시라도 노무현 대통령을 조롱의 의도로 밈으로 소비한다 한들, 그것이 품격 있는 행동이 아니더라도 그것을 이유로 한 세대를 싸잡아 비난하거나 일베몰이를 하지 않을 때가 된 것 같다”고 했다. 그러면서 “이제 노무현 대통령께서 성역이 아니라 여느 전직 대통령처럼 추억되었으면 좋겠다”며 “아주 작은 비석 하나만 남겨 달라는 마지막 말씀이 그 뜻이라 생각한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Ahn Cheol-soo: "Leverage on Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix Failed... KOSPI Has Become a Casino" (안철수 “삼전닉스 레버리지 실패...코스피가 카지노로 전락했다”)
item.description:
Ahn Cheol-soo: "Leverage on Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix Failed... KOSPI Has Become a Casino" (안철수 “삼전닉스 레버리지 실패...코스피가 카지노로 전락했다”)

Ahn Cheol-soo, a lawmaker from the People Power Party, on the 6th pointed to leveraged Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) based on Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix as the main culprits behind stock price volatility, stating that "the KOSPI has degenerated into a casino." He further urged President Lee Jae-myung to "hold the Chairman of the Financial Services Commission and the Governor of the Financial Supervisory Service accountable and dismiss them." (안철수 국민의힘 의원이 6일 삼성전자·SK하이닉스 레버리지 상장지수펀드(ETF)를 주가 변동성의 주범으로 지목하며 “코스피가 카지노로 전락했다”고 지적했다. 그러면서 이재명 대통령을 향해 “금융위원장과 금융감독원장에게 책임을 물어 파면해야 한다”고도 했다.)

In a Facebook post that day, Ahn said, "The leverage on 'Samjeonnix' (Samsung Electronics and Hynix) has been a complete policy failure," adding, "Therefore, strong corrective measures, including delisting, are necessary to normalize the stock market." He continued, "The 212 trillion won concentrated in Samjeonnix leveraged ETFs has amplified stock price volatility, turning the KOSPI into a casino." Indeed, this year alone, the stock market has triggered sidecars (a mechanism halting program trading for five minutes during sharp price swings) 31 times. There have also been five circuit breakers, which suspend all trading. <<> Regarding this, Ahn diagnosed, "By applying leverage to Samsung Electronics and Hynix, which account for 60% of the KOSPI's market capitalization, daily rebalancing and arbitrage attempts have destabilized the market, and the KOSPI fear index has soared to an all-time high of 90.8." He argued, "It would be more reasonable to ban leverage on single stocks and ease regulations on active ETFs tied to a correlation coefficient of 0.7." <<> He also raised the issue of accountability for the financial authorities that permitted such products. Targeting Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Eok-won and Financial Supervisory Service Governor Lee Chan-jin, Ahn criticized, "Both leaders have failed in foresight, response, and developing countermeasures." He asked, "Why is President Lee merely watching as irresponsible public officials cling to their posts and bide their time?" He further warned, "If the current 'roller-coaster KOSPI' trend continues, our stock market will be treated as an unpredictable 'junk stock' in global markets," adding, "Time is running out." (안 의원은 이날 페이스북에 “‘삼전닉스(삼성전자·하이닉스)’ 레버리지는 정책적으로 완전히 실패했다”며 “따라서 증시 정상화를 위해 상장폐지를 포함한 강력한 교정 방안이 필요하다”고 밝혔다. 이어 “삼전닉스 레버리지 ETF에 몰린 212조원의 자금이 주가 변동성을 증폭시켜 코스피가 카지노로 전락했다”고 했다. 실제 올해 들어 주식시장에선 사이드카(주가 급등락 때 프로그램 매매를 5분간 중지하는 장치)를 31번 발동했다. 거래 전체를 중단시키는 서킷 브레이커도 5차례나 있었다.)

item.title: [Breaking] Blue House recommends resignation of Lee Byung-tae… "Situation very serious" ([속보] 청와대, 이병태에 사퇴 권고… “사안 매우 엄중”)
item.description:
[Breaking] Blue House recommends resignation of Lee Byung-tae… "Situation very serious" ([속보] 청와대, 이병태에 사퇴 권고… “사안 매우 엄중”)

The Blue House announced on the 6th that it has recommended the resignation of Lee Byung-tae, vice-chairman of the Regulatory Reform Committee under the direct control of the president. (청와대가 이병태 대통령 직속 규제합리화위원회 부위원장에게 사퇴를 권고했다고 6일 밝혔다.)

This is because Vice-Chairman Lee sparked controversy by commenting, "The May 18 Democratization Movement has become a sanctuary," in relation to the so-called 'Starbucks cheer slogan' incident involving Baejae High School's baseball team. (이 부위원장이 배재고 야구부의 이른바 ‘스타벅스 응원 구호’ 논란에 “5·18이 성역이 됐다”고 발언한 것과 관련해 논란을 일으킨 탓이다.)

A Blue House official stated through a media notice on the same day, "The Blue House emphasized that as key members appointed to a presidential committee with significant responsibilities and authority, they must strive to align with the government's national policy direction, and implemented a warning measure." (청와대 관계자는 이날 언론 공지를 통해 “청와대는 책임과 권한이 큰 대통령 직속 위원회에 임명된 주요 구성원으로서 정부의 국정 기조에 부합하기 위해 노력해야 함을 강조하고, 경고 조치를 시행했다”고 했다.)

He further explained, "Since the matter was deemed very serious afterward, we recommended Vice-Chairman Lee's resignation, and he is currently assessing his own position." (또 “이후 사안이 매우 엄중한 까닭에 이 부위원장의 사퇴를 권고했고, 이에 이 부위원장이 스스로 거취를 판단하는 중”이라고 설명했다.)

He also emphasized, "The Lee Jae-myung administration will continue its efforts toward inclusiveness, expanding its reach beyond conservatives and progressives." (이어 “이재명 정부는 보수와 진보를 넘어 외연을 확장하는 포용의 노력을 지속해 나갈 것”이라고 강조했다.)

item.title: Pro-Chung Kye Campaigners: “Why Did Kim Min-seok Skip the Vote to Lift Martial Law?” “The Height of Irresponsibility” (與 친청계 “김민석, 계엄 해제 표결 왜 불참했나” “무책임의 극치”)
item.description:
Pro-Chung Kye Campaigners: “Why Did Kim Min-seok Skip the Vote to Lift Martial Law?” “The Height of Irresponsibility” (與 친청계 “김민석, 계엄 해제 표결 왜 불참했나” “무책임의 극치”)

Lee Seong-yoon, a Supreme Council member of the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 6th regarding former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, who declared his candidacy for party leadership, “Why didn’t you participate in the vote to lift martial law?” Lee is considered a key figure among the pro-Chung Kye faction within the party. Rep. Han Min-soo, who served as chief of staff to Representative Chung Kye, also stated, “Former Prime Minister Kim must give a clear and responsible answer to the public and party members regarding his irresponsible and self-contradictory remarks.” When Kim criticized former Representative Chung Kye in his candidacy declaration that day, the pro-Chung faction launched a unified counterattack. <<> Lee posted on Facebook that day, “After seeing former Prime Minister Kim’s declaration to run for party leadership, my first impression or thought was truly disappointing.” Regarding Kim’s reference to ‘the harmful effects of his own politics over the past year,’ Lee said, “A candidacy declaration that just blames and criticizes others is deplorable. Isn’t this precisely Kim’s own ‘harmful self-politics’ or ‘self-politics causing confusion in party-government cooperation’?” <<> Lee then brought up the phrase ‘the night of sleeplessness and determination’ from Kim’s declaration, asking, “As the entire nation knows, former Prime Minister Kim did not attend the National Assembly vote to lift Yoon Seok-youl’s martial law. Why didn’t you participate in the vote?” <<> He also said, “You claimed you were asleep after taking cold medicine—what was in that cold medicine?” He added, “There’s a saying that ‘you can wake someone who is sleeping, but you can’t wake someone pretending to sleep.’ Is that the case?” He continued, “It’s said that a Democratic Party lawmaker spoke with (former Prime Minister Kim) right before the martial law declaration. Then shouldn’t he have immediately rushed to the National Assembly?” This referred to Rep. Park Seon-won of the Democratic Party contacting Kim just before the martial law declaration. Previously, Rep. Park had explained this by saying, “There was talk that former President Yoon Seok-youl would issue a statement criticizing the Democratic Party, so I reported it via text message.” <<> Lee further stated, “(Former Prime Minister Kim) claimed that abolishing supplementary investigative powers was a consistent stance. He said he proposed the party handle reform plans containing supplementary investigative powers in May this year but that it was postponed at the party’s request. However, neither the party leader nor the floor leader says they received such a notification. Even I, as a Supreme Council member of the Democratic Party, have never discussed supplementary investigative powers at the Supreme Council.” He asked, “When and to whom did former Prime Minister Kim directly make this proposal? You can’t cover the sky with the palm of your hand. The truth will come out.” <<> Rep. Han Min-soo posted on Facebook that day targeting former Prime Minister Kim, saying, “If someone is challenging for the leadership of the ruling party, they should present a vision for the future, specific policy alternatives, and a direction, winning the hearts of party members and the public. Nevertheless, I can’t help but be disappointed to see you, from the very start of your candidacy, listing anachronistic and out-of-touch remarks.” <<> Rep. Han added, “If you’re going to point out that there was confusion, it’s common sense to present at least minimal evidence and specific examples. Are you just repeating assertions without any basis and trying to shift the blame entirely onto the party?” He continued, “Former Prime Minister Kim was the initial prime minister of the Lee Jae-myung administration, overseeing the entire cabinet and government operations. If there was indeed confusion between the party and the government, the prime minister himself can never be free from that responsibility. item.title: Kim Min-seok Announces Bid for Party Leadership... Takes Aim at Jeong Cheong-rae First (김민석, 與대표 출마... 정청래부터 저격했다)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok Announces Bid for Party Leadership... Takes Aim at Jeong Cheong-rae First (김민석, 與대표 출마... 정청래부터 저격했다)

On the 6th, former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok of the Democratic Party of Korea declared his candidacy for the August 17 party convention leadership election, stating, "If we are not desperate and strict now, we could fall into the quagmire of election defeat," and urged, "I appeal to party members and supporters to make the decision to replace the party leadership with a sense of urgent tension and fierce rigor." (더불어민주당 김민석 전 국무총리는 6일 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거 출마 선언에서 “지금 절박하고 엄격하지 않으면 우리는 총선 패배의 늪으로 빠져들 수 있다”며 “절박한 긴장감과 매서운 엄격함으로 당대표 교체의 결단을 내려주실 것을 당원과 지지자 여러분께 호소드린다”고 했다.)

The former Prime Minister Kim held a press conference at Jeonil Building 245 in Dong-gu, Gwangju, Jeonnam, on the same day, declaring, "I announce my candidacy for the Democratic Party leadership with an immense sense of responsibility for the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration." (김 전 총리는 이날 전남광주 동구 전일빌딩245에서 기자회견을 열어 “이재명 정부 국정성공에 대한 무한한 책임감 위에서 민주당 당대표 출마를 선언한다”고 했다.)

He directly targeted former leader Jeong Cheong-rae, saying, "Over the past year, the Democratic Party has failed to translate public support for the president and government into party support and election results," and added, "The harmful effects of self-centered politics over the past year have thrown the party and party-government cooperation into confusion." (그는 “민주당은 지난 1년, 대통령과 정부에 대한 국정 지지를 정당 지지와 선거결과로 연결시키지 못했다”며 “지난 1년, 자기 정치의 폐해가 당과 당정 협력을 혼선에 빠뜨렸다”고 정청래 전 대표를 직격했다.)

Continuing his criticism of leader Jeong, Kim said, "At this rate, it’s difficult to achieve governmental success, election victory, or party unity," and noted that "insufficient deliberation, lack of debate, procedural gaps, and inconsistency in areas like coalition promotion, prosecution reform discussions, candidate nominations, and election strategies have caused many problems." (김 전 총리는 “이대로는 국정 성공도, 총선 승리도, 당의 단합도 어렵다”며 “합당 추진, 검찰 개혁 논의, 공천과 선거 전략 등에서 나타난 숙의 부족, 토론 부족, 절차 미비, 일관성 부족은 많은 문제를 낳았다”고 정 대표 비판을 이어갔다.)

Kim stated, "If the Lee Jae-myung administration succeeds, a golden age for South Korea will unfold, like America’s New Deal era or Sweden’s welfare state era. A major shift toward region-led growth will begin, and the industrial map of South Korea will change," emphasizing, "At this historic moment, the party must not become a burden to governance or a source of conflict." (김 전 총리는 “이재명 정부가 성공하면 미국의 뉴딜 시대, 스웨덴의 복지국가 시대처럼 대한민국의 황금시대가 열린다. 지방 주도 성장의 대격변이 시작되고, 대한민국의 산업 지도가 바뀐다”며 “이런 역사적 시점에 당이 국정의 짐이나 갈등의 진원이 되어서는 안 된다”고 했다.)

While acknowledging the previous leadership, Kim said, "I commend the efforts of the past leadership from a comradely perspective. You have worked hard," but added, "However, accountability for results is a basic ethic of politics and political parties." This was a veiled attribution of responsibility for the outcomes of the June 3 local and by-elections. (김 전 총리는 그러면서 정청래 지도부를 향해 “지난 지도부의 노력을 동지적 관점에서 치하한다. 수고 많으셨다”면서도 “그러나 결과 책임은 정치와 정당의 기본 윤리”라고 했다. 6·3 지방선거 및 재보궐선거 결과에 대한 책임을 돌린 것이다.)

Kim argued, "Kim Dae-jung, Roh Moo-hyun, Moon Jae-in, and Lee Jae-myung are not subjects for division or derogatory name-calling; they are absolute assets and a shared history of the Democratic Party and the democratic camp," and stressed that "only complete party-government harmony and a pragmatic, integrated approach for the people represent the proven path to victory under four democratic administrations." (김 전 총리는 “김대중·노무현·문재인·이재명은 갈라치기와 멸칭의 대상이 될 수 없는, 민주당과 민주 진영의 절대 자산이고 공통 역사”라며 “완벽한 당정 일치와 민생 실용 통합 노선만이 네 번의 민주정부에서 검증된 필승 노선”이라고 했다.)

He claimed, "I created the 50:50 national primary system, the inclusion of party member votes in parliamentary elections, and the term 'era of party member sovereignty,'" and promised, "I will open an era of stronger 'true party member sovereignty.'" He added, "I consolidated my consistent stance on abolishing supplementary investigative powers into government policy. On that foundation, I will continue to push for prosecution and judicial reform. I will also pursue media reform at a higher level. By reviving the democratic party management methods from Lee Jae-myung’s leadership era, I will restore deliberation and debate. I will immediately begin restoring the fairness of the damaged system-based candidate selection." (그는 “5:5 국민 경선도, 의원직 선거에 당원 투표 반영도, 당원 주권 시대라는 조어도 제 작품”이라며 “더 강한 ‘진짜 당원 주권’의 시대를 열겠다”고 했다. 이어 “보완수사권 폐지라는 제 일관된 주장을 정부의 입장으로 정리했다. 그 바탕 위에 검찰 개혁, 사법 개혁의 과제를 계속 추진할 것”이라고 했다. 또 “한 단계 높은 언론 개혁도 추진할 것”이라며 “이재명 대표 시절의 민주적 당 운영방식을 부활시켜 숙의와 토론을 살릴 것이다. 훼손된 시스템 공천의 공정성 회복 작업도 즉각 시작할 것”이라고 했다.)

Kim concluded, "We must restore the capable Democratic Party, the strong Democratic Party, and the winning Democratic Party from Lee Jae-myung’s leadership era. I will boost the party’s approval ratings, unite the party, its members, and its support base under the right direction, and charge toward election victory," urging, "I ask that all party members—including delegates and rights-bearing members—participate without exception in the one-member, one-vote exercise of party member sovereignty to overwhelmingly decide to replace the party leadership." (김 전 총리는 “이재명 대표 시절의 유능한 민주당, 강한 민주당, 이기는 민주당을 복원해야 한다”며 “당의 지지율을 반등시키고, 올바른 노선하에 당과 당원과 지지층을 통합하고, 총선승리로 달려가겠다”고 했다. 이어 “(대의원·권리당원) 1인 1표 당원 주권 행사에 모든 당원이 한 분도 빠짐없이 참여해 압도적 결의로 당의 리더십을 교체해달라”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee Tells PM Han, Who Reported on 'Four Key Tasks', "Take Full Authority to Lead National Innovation" (李대통령, ‘4대 역점 과제’ 보고한 韓총리에 “전권 갖고 국정 혁신 이끌어 달라”)
item.description:
President Lee Tells PM Han, Who Reported on 'Four Key Tasks', "Take Full Authority to Lead National Innovation" (李대통령, ‘4대 역점 과제’ 보고한 韓총리에 “전권 갖고 국정 혁신 이끌어 달라”)

New Prime Minister Han Seong-sook reported to President Lee Jae-myung on the 6th that, as Prime Minister, she would focus on four key areas: an 'AI (Artificial Intelligence) transformation', 'regulatory rationalization', 'a startup renaissance', and 'enhancing youth policies'. President Lee Jae-myung instructed, "Take full authority as Prime Minister and lead fundamental innovation across all state affairs." (한성숙 신임 국무총리가 6일 이재명 대통령에게 총리로서 ‘AI(인공지능) 대전환’과 ‘규제 합리화’ ‘창업 르네상스’ ‘청년 정책 내실화’ 등 네 가지 사항에 힘을 쏟겠다고 보고했다. 이재명 대통령은 “총리가 전권을 갖고, 국정 전반에 걸쳐 근본적인 혁신을 이끌어 달라”고 주문했다.)

According to the Prime Minister's Office, PM Han held her first weekly report meeting with President Lee, combined with lunch, at the Presidential Office (Cheong Wa Dae) on this day, since taking office on the 1st. (총리실에 따르면, 한 총리는 이날 청와대에서 지난 1일 총리 취임 후 처음으로 이 대통령과 오찬을 겸한 주례 보고 회동을 했다.)

The weekly report meeting is a regular session where the President and Prime Minister meet each week to share their understanding of the overall state of national affairs and current issues, and to discuss the direction of government operations. It is typically held every Monday at the Presidential Office, accompanied by lunch. The Chief of Staff to the President, the Director of National Affairs, and from the Prime Minister's Office, the Minister of the Office for Government Policy Coordination, attend. At this meeting, the Head of the Policy Office and the Head of the National Security Office from the Presidential Office also attended. (주례 보고 회동은 대통령과 총리가 매주 정례적으로 만나 국정 전반의 상황과 현안에 대한 인식을 공유하고 정부 운영 방향을 협의하는 자리로, 통상적으로 매주 월요일 청와대에서 오찬과 함께 진행된다. 청와대에서 대통령비서실장과 국정상황실장, 총리실에서 국무조정실장이 배석한다. 이번 회동에는 청와대 정책실장과 국가안보실장도 배석했다.)

PM Han reported to President Lee that she would set the AI transformation, regulatory rationalization, startup renaissance, and enhancement of youth policies as her 'Four Key Prime Ministerial Agenda Items'. (한 총리는 이 대통령에게 AI 대전환과 규제 합리화, 창업 르네상스, 청년 정책 내실화를 ‘총리 4대 역점 어젠다’로 삼겠다고 보고했다.)

President Lee expressed trust in PM Han's expertise in the IT (Information Technology) field and her experience in private-sector innovation, and emphasized, "As Prime Minister with full authority, please lead fundamental innovation not only in the way the public service operates but also across all state affairs, including regulatory rationalization, startups, and youth policies." (이 대통령은 한 총리의 IT(정보기술) 분야 전문성과 민간 혁신 경험에 대한 신뢰를 표하고, “총리가 전권을 갖고 공직사회의 일하는 방식뿐만 아니라 규제 합리화, 창업, 청년 정책 등 국정 전반에 걸쳐 근본적인 혁신을 이끌어 달라”고 강조했다.)

PM Han also reported on 'Measures to protect citizens' lives based on AI and data'. (한 총리는 ‘AI·데이터 기반 국민 생명 보호 방안’도 보고했다.)

In response, President Lee instructed, "Prepare groundbreaking measures that can protect and save citizens' lives through technology and pursue them swiftly." (이에 대해 이 대통령은 “기술로 국민의 생명을 지키고 살릴 수 있는 획기적인 방안을 마련해 신속히 추진하라”고 지시했다.)

The Prime Minister's Office stated, "President Lee and PM Han decided to continue inspecting and discussing key national issues, centering on the weekly report meetings, and to cooperate closely to generate national achievements." (총리실은 “이 대통령과 한 총리는 앞으로도 주례 보고 회동을 중심으로 주요 국정 현안을 점검·논의하고, 국정 성과 창출을 위해 긴밀히 협력해 나가기로 했다”고 전했다.)

item.title: [Breaking] Presidential Office: "Honam Semiconductor Cluster to Be Built on Gwangju Air Base Site" ([속보] 靑 “호남 반도체 클러스터, 광주 군공항 부지에 조성”)
item.description:
[Breaking] Presidential Office: "Honam Semiconductor Cluster to Be Built on Gwangju Air Base Site" ([속보] 靑 “호남 반도체 클러스터, 광주 군공항 부지에 조성”)

Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik announced on the 6th that the Honam region semiconductor cluster, promoted as part of the "three major mega projects," has been decided to be built on the site of Gwangju Air Base. (강훈식 대통령 비서실장은 6일 ‘3대 메가 프로젝트’ 일환으로 추진하는 호남권 반도체 클러스터를 광주 군공항 부지에 조성하기로 결정했다고 밝혔다.)

During a briefing after a public-private joint inspection meeting for the promotion of the three major mega projects held at the presidential office, Chief Kang said, "Regarding semiconductor investment in the Honam region, we discussed the first step, which is the site," adding, "Companies expressed that among the candidate locations in the Honam region, the Gwangju Air Base area is the most suitable." Previously, Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix announced plans to invest 800 trillion won to build four semiconductor fabs (factories) in the Honam region. (강 실장은 이날 청와대에서 3대 메가 프로젝트 추진을 위한 민관 합동 점검 회의를 가진 뒤 브리핑에서 “호남권 반도체 투자와 관련해 그 첫 단계인 부지 관련해 논의했다”며 “기업들은 호남권 입지 후보지 중에 광주 군공항 지역이 가장 적합하다는 의견을 제시했다”고 말했다. 앞서 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스는 800조원을 투자해 호남에 반도체 팹(fab·공장) 4기를 건설하겠다고 밝혔다.)

Chief Kang stated, "The Gwangju Air Base area can secure a site of about 2.5 million pyeong (approximately 8.26 square kilometers), and due to its nature as an airfield, the land has already been leveled, which has the advantage of minimizing the site preparation period." He added, "It is adjacent to downtown Gwangju and the KTX station, offering strengths in securing personnel and living conditions, and it also has excellent logistics accessibility connected to roads, airports, and ports. Accordingly, at today's meeting, we decided to create a Honam semiconductor industrial complex on the Gwangju Air Base site." (강 실장은 “광주 군공항 지역은 약 250만평 규모의 부지 확보가 가능하고, 공항 특성상 이미 평탄화가 완료되어 있는 만큼 부지 공사 기간을 최소화할 수 있는 장점이 있다”고 했다. 이어 “광주 도심, KTX 역에 인접해 있어 인력 확보와 정주 여건 측면에서 강점이 있고 도로, 공항, 항만 등과 연계한 물류 접근성도 우수하다”며 “이에 따라 오늘 회의에서 광주 군공항 부지에 호남권 반도체 산단을 조성하기로 결정했다”고 말했다.)

Chief Kang said, "The government will swiftly complete the candidate site selection process through consultations with relevant ministries and begin subsequent procedures for the development of the industrial complex." (강 실장은 “정부는 관계 부처 협의를 거쳐 조속히 후보지 선정 절차를 마무리하고 산단 개발을 위한 후속 절차에 착수하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: [Breaking] Lee Byung-tae, Vice Chairman of the Regulation Rationalization Committee, Resigns Amid Controversy Over '5·18 Sanctuary' Remarks ([속보] 이병태 규제합리화부위원장, ‘5·18 성역' 논란으로 사퇴)
item.description:
[Breaking] Lee Byung-tae, Vice Chairman of the Regulation Rationalization Committee, Resigns Amid Controversy Over '5·18 Sanctuary' Remarks ([속보] 이병태 규제합리화부위원장, ‘5·18 성역' 논란으로 사퇴)

The Blue House announced on the 6th that Vice Chairman Lee Byung-tae of the Regulation Rationalization Committee, who sparked controversy by criticizing Baejae High School's baseball team's "Starbucks cheering song" with the question "Is 5·18 a sanctuary?", has expressed his intention to resign, and this has been accepted. Despite repeated calls for his resignation from the ruling party, Vice Chairman Lee had not previously indicated his intention to step down. However, after the Blue House issued a statement that afternoon recommending his resignation, he conveyed his decision to voluntarily resign. (이 부위원장은 여권의 잇따른 사퇴 요구에도 사퇴 의사를 밝히지 않았지만, 이날 오후 청와대가 “이 부위원장의 사퇴를 권고했다”는 입장을 내자 자진 사퇴 의사를 전한 것이다.)

item.title: Rep. Kim Hyun-jung of the Democratic Party: "Three Mega Projects, Parliamentary Investigation? Special Counsel? Stop the Hyena Politics of the People Power Party" (與 김현정 “3대 메가 프로젝트 국정조사? 특검? 국힘 하이에나 정치 그만두길”)
item.description:
Rep. Kim Hyun-jung of the Democratic Party: "Three Mega Projects, Parliamentary Investigation? Special Counsel? Stop the Hyena Politics of the People Power Party" (與 김현정 “3대 메가 프로젝트 국정조사? 특검? 국힘 하이에나 정치 그만두길”)

Rep. Kim Hyun-jung of the Democratic Party of Korea strongly criticized Rep. Na Kyung-won of the People Power Party for criticizing the plan to create the Honam Semiconductor National Industrial Complex, calling her the "vanguard of Honam hatred" and engaging in "hyena-style politics." (더불어민주당 김현정 의원이 호남 반도체 국가산업단지 조성 계획 등을 비판한 국민의힘 나경원 의원을 향해 “호남 혐오의 선봉장” “하이에나식 정치”라고 강하게 비판했다.)

In a Facebook post today, Rep. Kim stated, "They are degrading a future industry that should be discussed over 20 to 30 years of the nation's time as a 'show for a party convention' and insulting the opportunities of Honam youth as 'vote-seeking.'" (김 의원은 이날 자신의 페이스북에 “국가의 20년, 30년을 걸고 논의해야 할 미래 산업을 ‘전당대회용 쇼’로 깎아내리고 호남 청년들의 기회를 ‘표몰이’라고 모욕했다”고 했다.)

She continued, "When corporate heads are summoned to discuss future strategies, they call it a 'prop' or a 'rip-off show,' and when long-term investments are promised, they twist it into 'investments forced by pressure' and attack it. Can national strategy be degraded this much unless it is hyena politics, constantly searching for tomorrow's headlines?" (이어 “기업 총수들을 불러 미래 전략을 논의하면 ‘들러리’, ‘갈취 쇼’라고 하고, 장기 투자를 약속하면 ‘압박에 떠밀린 투자’라고 뒤틀어 공격한다”며 “내일의 기사거리만 찾아 헤매는 하이에나 정치가 아니고서야 국가 전략을 이렇게까지 깎아내릴 수 있느냐”고 비판했다.)

Regarding Rep. Na's mention of a parliamentary investigation and special counsel, Rep. Kim said, "This is merely a call to waste administrative capacity through wasteful political strife. It is not worth paying attention to any longer." (김 의원은 나 의원이 국정조사와 특검을 거론한 데 대해서도 “소모적 정쟁으로 행정력을 낭비하자는 이야기일 뿐”이라며 “더 이상 들어줄 가치도 없다”고 했다.)

On the other hand, regarding the remarks of former Rep. Lee Jung-hyun, a member of the People Power Party, she said, "In relation to the Honam semiconductor debate, former Rep. Lee stated, 'The underdevelopment and neglect of Honam is not just a problem for Honam, but a problem for the Republic of Korea, and I hope the conservatives will take this issue to heart first.' In that one sentence, I saw what dignified conservatism is." (반면 국민의힘 소속인 이정현 전 의원의 발언에 대해선 “이 전 의원은 호남 반도체 논쟁과 관련해 ‘호남의 낙후와 소외는 호남만의 문제가 아니라 대한민국의 문제이며, 보수가 이 일을 먼저 품었으면 좋겠다’고 말했다”며 “이 한마디에서 품격 있는 보수가 무엇인지 봤다”고 밝혔다.)

She then asserted, "While one side of the conservatives talks about affection for Honam and the future of the Republic of Korea, Rep. Na is caught up in fear and jealousy over Honam's potential development, using even the future of the nation and businesses as fuel for political strife." (그러면서 “보수의 한쪽에서는 호남을 향한 애정과 대한민국의 미래를 이야기하는 반면, 나 의원은 호남이 발전할 것 같은 두려움과 질투에 사로잡혀 국가와 기업의 미래까지 정쟁의 불쏘시개로 삼고 있다”고 주장했다.)

Rep. Kim concluded, "Just by comparing former Rep. Lee Jung-hyun and Rep. Na Kyung-won, the people can see which type of conservatism the Republic of Korea needs and which type of politics represents outdated politics that deserve to be judged. I recommend that Rep. Na stop her low-grade hyena politics and learn from former Rep. Lee what conservatism truly is." (김 의원은 “이정현 전 의원과 나경원 의원의 대비만으로도 어떤 보수가 대한민국에 필요한지, 어떤 정치가 심판받아야 할 낡은 정치인지 국민은 보고 있다”며 “나 의원은 저급한 하이에나 정치를 그만두고 이 전 의원에게 보수가 무엇인지 배우길 권고한다”고 했다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Gwangju Military Airport Designated for Semiconductor Site, Ammunition Depot Relocation Canceled... Potential Loss of 300 Billion Won ([단독] 광주군공항, 반도체 부지 지정에 탄약고 이전 무산... 3000억 날릴 듯)
item.description:
[Exclusive] Gwangju Military Airport Designated for Semiconductor Site, Ammunition Depot Relocation Canceled... Potential Loss of 300 Billion Won ([단독] 광주군공항, 반도체 부지 지정에 탄약고 이전 무산... 3000억 날릴 듯)

With the decision to develop the Honam Semiconductor National Industrial Complex on the Gwangju military airport site, the relocation project for the Mareuk-dong ammunition depot in Gwangju, pursued for over 20 years, has effectively been canceled, it has been confirmed. (광주 군공항 부지에 호남 반도체 국가산업단지를 조성하기로 결정되면서, 20년 넘게 추진돼 온 광주 마륵동 탄약고 이전 사업이 사실상 무산된 것으로 확인됐다.)

According to an official from the South Jeolla-Gwangju Integrated Special City, the Ministry of National Defense and Gwangju Metropolitan City had originally been pushing ahead with a project to move the ammunition depot in the Seo-gu Mareuk-dong and Geumho-dong area to near Gwangju military airport since 2005. The total project cost was 326.2 billion won, of which 268.1 billion won had been spent by last year, with construction planned to start next year. Representative Yang Bu-nam of the Democratic Party of Korea, the lawmaker for the district, had even promoted that 5 billion won in national budget had been secured for the 2026 budget. The new ammunition depot site had already been purchased and largely leveled. (전남광주통합특별시 관계자에 따르면, 당초 국방부와 광주광역시는 서구 마륵동·금호동 일대 탄약고를 광주 군공항 인근으로 옮기는 사업을 2005년부터 추진해왔다. 총사업비는 3262억원으로, 지난해까지 2681억원이 집행됐고 내년부터 착공될 계획이었다. 해당 지역구 의원인 더불어민주당 양부남 의원도 2026년 본예산에 50억 원의 국비 예산이 확정되었다며 홍보한 바 있다. 새 탄약고 부지는 이미 매입과 평탄화 작업까지 대부분 끝난 상태였다.)

However, the situation changed early this year when the Presidential Office and the Ministry of National Defense discussed utilizing the Gwangju military airport site for the Honam Semiconductor National Industrial Complex. This effectively requires halting the ammunition depot relocation project to make way for the semiconductor complex. It is now highly likely that the ammunition depot will be moved to an entirely new site around 10 years from now, when the Gwangju military airport is scheduled to relocate to Muan. (하지만 올해 초 청와대와 국방부가 광주 군공항 부지를 호남 반도체 국가산단으로 활용하는 방안을 논의하면서 상황이 바뀌었다. 반도체 산단 조성을 위해 탄약고 이전 사업을 사실상 중단해야 한다는 것이다. 탄약고는 광주 군공항이 무안으로 이전할 즈음인 10년 뒤 아예 새 부지로 이전할 가능성이 커졌다.)

Residents near the ammunition depot are also expected to protest. For decades, residents around the Mareuk-dong ammunition depot have been restricted in their property rights due to designation as a military facility protection zone. The Ministry of National Defense and political figures had extensively promoted budget allocations and project progress, but now complaints are arising that the change in government policy has reset the entire project back to square one. (탄약고 인근 주민들의 반발도 예상된다. 마륵동 탄약고 주변 주민들은 수십 년째 군사시설 보호구역으로 묶여 재산권 행사에 제약을 받아왔다. 그동안 국방부와 정치권도 예산 확보와 사업 추진을 대대적으로 홍보했지만, 정부 정책이 바뀌면서 사업 자체가 원점으로 돌아갔다는 불만이 나온다.)
